provider: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI)
catalog_rule: Discovery portals and search tools are connectors and do not count as individual ATLAS resources. Only record-level items with verifiable metadata count.

access_policy.public_full_text: May be referenced and ingested only according to the item's stated rights and access terms.
access_policy.metadata_only_or_commercial: Store metadata and official availability link only; do not copy restricted copyrighted content.
access_policy.restricted_or_controlled: Do not ingest protected, controlled, classified, UCNI, CUI, or otherwise access-restricted content.
access_policy.datasets: Dataset records must point to a publicly accessible repository/landing page; preserve DOI when available.
access_policy.software: Preserve repository/source provenance and license before any local code ingestion.

quality_gate: No generic, invented, inferred, or unverified DOE resource may be marked verified or counted toward Bookshelf population totals.
